commands.cmd: python3 -c "import re,sys; t=open('docs/build_judgments.md').read(); b=re.split(r'^## ',t,flags=re.M)[1:]; n=len(b); ok=[s for s in b if ('Silent at' in s or 'Contradictory at' in s) and 'Decided by' in s and 'Recorded' in s]; print('entries:',n,'| entries naming the silent contract location, decider and record:',len(ok)); sys.exit(0 if (n==len(ok) and 0<n<=8 and 'M3 edition' in t) else 1)"
commands.output_tail: entries: 8 | entries naming the silent contract location, decider and record: 8

commands.cmd: python3 -c "import re,sys; t=open('docs/build_judgments.md').read(); n=len(re.findall(r'^## ',t,re.M)); m='M3 edition' in t; print('entries:',n,'| names itself the M3 edition:',m); sys.exit(0 if (m and n<=8) else 1)"
commands.output_tail: entries: 8 | names itself the M3 edition: True
